events.snippet: Logged chassis asymmetry: Right folded bottom edge sits high (WAL-11).
identified metal deformation: Square dimples pillowed at slide-lock (WAL-15).
Flagged finish failure: Black zinc chips after multiple Bazooka installs (WAL-10).
Circulated updated Mechanical Test-related issue tracker via email.
Initiated Crush Test protocols for Waldo chassis validation.
Z-Axis Analysis: Detected collision risk (-0.06mm interference) in worst-case stack.
Z-Axis Analysis: Detected float risk (0.34mm gap) in loose tolerance scenario.
X-Axis Verdict: Confirmed 'Snaps will always go through holes' (0.9mm clearance).
Bazooka Interaction: Identified 0mm clearance risk between cover plate and module top.
Y-Axis Verdict: Nominal engagement confirmed at 0.5mm; Minimum WC at 0.3mm.
Perimeter Analysis: 4-gang tolerances derived from 2-gang parts (0.48mm RSS gap).
Defined Impact Test: 1kg pendulum, hard rubber head, 20cm drop height.
